acceptance_criteria.text: New and reconciled US-listed securities use stable FIGI-domain keys where applicable, issuer identity is separate from security identity, effective-dated listing/provider-symbol history is retained, and unresolved candidates are quarantined without silent merges.
Canonical bars distinguish instrument, market/feed scope, session, timeframe, adjustment basis/version, and provenance; existing OHLCV reads remain compatible through a default series mapping.
Exchange sessions, timezones, holidays, early closes, overnight trade-date rules, and user-local projections are versioned and used by freshness and daily-completion logic.

Provider routing filters by capability, asset/venue/session/interval/history/feed/terms entitlement, health, quota, and workload budget; quota reservations are safe across workers and every decision is observable.

Whole-universe core-session D1 refresh, tiered intraday polling, local rollups, exact missing-slice repair, request coalescing, deferred broad-evaluator runs, and automatic retry are implemented without provider calls inside evaluation loops.

Provider adapters cover the approved practical roster, with US identity/lifecycle, OHLCV, corporate actions, market events, SEC facts/core fundamentals, earnings, FINRA short interest, crypto, current options, and optional futures paths represented honestly by capability and provenance.

Current option chains and quotes are retained; QuantLib-backed American-option Greeks and the existing fallback are labeled with model/version/input provenance and tested against numerical edge cases.

Backend-only admin and diagnostic APIs expose capabilities, entitlements, quota/cost usage, routing decisions, coverage, identity quarantine, sessions, queue/degradation state, anomalies, and detailed shadow reports.

New routing defaults remain disabled until a separately approved deployed 30-day shadow run produces automated daily/final reports, at least 99% eligible core-session D1 coverage before the next regular session, no silent identity/license/quota violations, and AI-readable discrepancy evidence.
Existing symbol-based API aliases and legacy yfinance-dependent paths remain functional only through explicit compatibility behavior; yfinance is absent from default and acceptance routing.

Focused unit, adapter-fixture, migration, PostgreSQL/Redis integration, worker, API, numerical, point-in-time, and full backend integration validation pass; every live-enabled provider has either bounded keyless evidence or an explicit credential preflight failure; no frontend files are modified.

No provider policy contains a generic 60/min, 15-burst, 2-concurrency, or 30-second fallback. Unknown limits are represented as NULL/unknown, excluded from routing, and surfaced with the exact missing contract dimensions.

429/418/quota responses parse provider reset headers where present, stop the affected provider scope, persist a typed capacity event, defer work until the reset (or operator decision), and do not create a retry storm or unsafe fallback.

The manifest-driven live matrix covers keyless and credentialed providers separately. Missing credentials identify exact environment variables and block ready-for-review; no live skip is represented as proof.

Local worktrees, GitHub live validation, and deployment targets use separate explicit secret stores; no credential is tracked, routine PR CI receives no provider secret, and provider credentials reach only trusted backend/worker processes.

next_action: Restore Docker readiness for the required full-profile session bootstrap and execute the independent-client Redis contention test; execute the new bounded Alpha EARNINGS_CALENDAR live case and the EDGAR IPO-pipeline read only after the shared provider quota/contact gates permit it; then keep deferred-provider preflights, provider-specific quota/legal/terms reviews, venue reconciliation, secret distribution, and separately approved 30-day shadow gates open; keep MarketData.app response-dependent chain/quote routing fail-closed until a reviewed reservation bound exists. The normalized market-event persistence/worker path is implemented and disabled by default, and its authenticated database-only calendar read API is now available; next event work is cross-provider reconciliation, pre-listing materialization, bounded EDGAR candidate-batch operations, and frontend calendar surfaces. Adjustment-aware resolver and direct-adapter guards filter every currently raw-only history adapter before adjusted transport, raw exchange bars retain explicit provenance, canonical bar persistence retains series/session/adjustment/provenance metadata through migrations 8e9f0a1b2c3d and 9f0a1b2c3d4e, compatibility OHLCV reads use the durable default mapping from migration a0b1c2d3e4f5, cold/latest provider fetches attach the same deterministic series identity, bulk/risk-free persistence follows that path too, synthetic readback applies the selector, empty canonical scopes retain legacy history until matching bars exist, mixed provider scopes are partitioned into distinct series, tokenized refresh failures are redacted at the service boundary, typed rate-limit errors filter transport metadata at construction, FINRA/Tiingo/FMP published bandwidth pools use conservative decimal-byte ceilings with explicit limit_basis metadata, production provider-rate seeds are regression-guarded against generic limiter defaults, Dinari live coverage spans DAY/WEEK/MONTH/YEAR aggregate history, Alpaca and MarketData.app live coverage include five-minute history, latest-price refreshes now recheck cache under keyed process/Redis ownership, and latest complete 44-case live evidence is recorded under run e0e58468-df1a-493b-bfc4-f20fdce5a568.

progress.current_blocker: The latest complete matrix collects 44 cases and passes 39/44. The supplied Alpaca paper, SEC EDGAR, MarketData.app, and rotated Dinari Sandbox credentials pass the current bounded matrix, including five-minute Alpaca/MarketData.app history and all four Dinari aggregate history windows; aggregate telemetry remains in the owner-managed external ledger. Alpha Vantage returned typed provider-native 25-requests/day capacity responses for IPO-calendar and earnings after the shared key was exercised; the new bounded EARNINGS_CALENDAR live case is added but remains pending a daily-quota reset and is not represented as live success. Tradier, Ondo, and IBKR are intentionally deferred and remain exact missing-key preflights. MarketData.app option/quote transport is live-proven, but response-dependent chain/quote credits remain unroutable without a reviewed reservation bound. FRED, FINRA OTC/async, Nasdaq, tokenized-provider terms/quota, Marketstack discovery, Tiingo/FMP byte maps, NMS/OTC reconciliation, GitHub CI secret distribution, deployment-owned SEC contact distribution, and separately approved 30-day shadow gates remain open. Docker readiness is unavailable for the required full-profile session bootstrap, so the new independent-client Redis contention regression is not yet executed. The normalized market-event persistence/worker path is now implemented but disabled by default; its authenticated database-only calendar read API and bounded EDGAR CIK pipeline service are available, while cross-provider reconciliation, pre-listing materialization, global EDGAR candidate enumeration, and frontend calendar surfaces remain open. Alpha Vantage free daily history rejects adjusted requests explicitly; resolver admission and direct adapter guards filter every currently raw-only history adapter before adjusted-history transport, raw exchange bars retain explicit provenance, and the registry advertises adjusted_price_history only for admitted providers. Canonical bar persistence retains series/session/adjustment/provenance metadata through migrations 8e9f0a1b2c3d and 9f0a1b2c3d4e; compatibility OHLCV reads use the durable default mapping from migration a0b1c2d3e4f5. Tokenized refresh-service failure summaries now use bounded provider-message redaction before returning per-asset/event errors. Typed ProviderRateLimitError headers now filter transport metadata at construction, preventing direct-adapter leakage before durable filtering. Cross-host OHLCV canonical, bulk, and latest-price refreshes now support explicit tokenized Redis locks with bounded wait/TTL and fail-closed acquisition; latest-price cache state is rechecked while ownership is held. The complete backend unit suite passes 1,850/1,850, but these code-level and live-evidence results do not substitute for the blocked Docker-backed migration/full-stack gate.
progress.next_action: Restore Docker readiness and run the independent-client Redis contention test; execute the bounded Alpha EARNINGS_CALENDAR live case and EDGAR IPO-pipeline read after the shared provider quota/contact gates permit it; then keep deferred-provider preflights explicit, complete provider-specific quota/legal and venue-reconciliation reviews, retain provider-native usage accounting, and do not activate MarketData.app chain/quote routing or deploy until all gates are satisfied. Keep adjusted_price_history as an explicit semantic capability rather than inferring it from price_history; verify migrations 8e9f0a1b2c3d, 9f0a1b2c3d4e, and a0b1c2d3e4f5 in the full stack before promotion. Confirm historical, latest, bulk, risk-free, and synthetic provider/read paths retain the selected series identity, verify legacy fallback when canonical scopes are empty, validate mixed provider scope partitioning against PostgreSQL constraints, retain allow-listed transport headers on typed rate-limit failures, preserve the explicit conservative decimal-byte basis for published FINRA/Tiingo/FMP bandwidth pools, validate the latest-price Redis gate with independent clients, and review the new market-event persistence service before adding reconciliation/pre-listing work.
